newsitem.title: UK: Both Brent dates kept, Dated trades at May -68 cts.
newsitem.headline: Both Brent dates kept, Dated trades at May -68 cts.

text.p: Both Brent crude cargoes nominated from the paper chains on Tuesday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
The cargoes, due to load April 2-4, were kept by British Petroleum, traders said.
Meanwhile, a March 26-28 cargo traded at May Brent -68 cents a barrel, two cents firmer than a deal earlier in the day.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
